distribution_status: The CELLS are PRIVATE donor-derived output and are NOT in this repository. This file is their provenance record only -- hashes, row counts and wall clock. See docs/artifact-manifest.json.
purpose: A container restart on 2026-09-24 killed the run mid-cell. /tmp survived that one. This file is what lets a regenerated cell be checked for IDENTITY against the cell it replaces, rather than assumed equal to it.
